title: Installment Settlement Start, Deficiency Balance Accounts: System Reference
content:
**Policy.** This policy figures the monthly installment of an installment settlement when the settlement is started on one account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts, over no more than the band's maximum number of settlement installments.

The installment of an installment settlement is fixed only after the account carries an installment settlement offer that the borrower has accepted.

An account carrying no installment settlement offer with the status accepted has no settlement the settlement rule allows to start, and its settlement installment is nil (0.00).

| Account record | Settlement installment |
|---|---|
| Carries an installment settlement offer the borrower has accepted | Fixed on the account |
| Carries no accepted installment settlement offer | Nil (0.00); no settlement may be started |

## The start tool

`start_installment_settlement_185f50ba` is a representative's tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it. It starts an accepted installment settlement on a borrower's Deficiency Balance Account. The account moves to status `on_settlement_plan` with the given accepted settlement as its arrangement in force; the settlement records the monthly installment given, the number of installments that installment needs to pay the settlement amount (the settlement amount divided by the installment, rounded up to a whole installment), and a first due date one month after the acceptance on the acceptance's day of the month (the 28th when that day is the 29th, 30th or 31st). The balance does not change.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deficiency_account_id` | The reference number of the Deficiency Balance Account the settlement is started on, as returned by the deficiency account lookup for this borrower | Account reference number |
| `arrangement_offer_id` | The reference number of the accepted installment settlement, as returned when the borrower accepted it or by the arrangement offer lookup | Offer reference number |
| `installment_amount_usd` | The monthly settlement installment | USD, 2 decimal places; rounded half up to 2 decimal places when recorded |

### Receipt

- `status`: "started" when the settlement is in force
- `deficiency_account_id`: the account
- `account_status`: always `on_settlement_plan`
- `arrangement_offer_id`: the settlement in force
- `offer_amount_usd`: the settlement amount, USD, 2 decimal places
- `installment_amount_usd`: USD, 2 decimal places
- `installment_count`: integer number of monthly installments
- `first_due_date`: YYYY-MM-DD

## Basis Q&A

**When is the first installment due?** One month after the acceptance, on the acceptance's day of the month; an acceptance on the 30th of a month gives a first due date on the 28th of the next month.

**Does starting the settlement change the balance?** No; the balance stays as it was.
